title: UX Designer Learning Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to move from zero experience to a portfolio‑ready UX designer. Focuses on research, design fundamentals, and job‑ready skills.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build a solid understanding of design thinking and basic UX concepts.

milestones.title: Design Thinking Basics
milestones.outcome: Can explain the five stages of design thinking and apply them to simple problems.

tasks.title: Read Design Thinking overview
tasks.description: Study the introductory article on the Interaction Design Foundation site.

tasks.title: Watch Design Thinking video
tasks.description: Watch the freeCodeCamp video on design thinking fundamentals.

tasks.title: Create a problem statement
tasks.description: Write a clear problem statement for a daily frustration you notice.

tasks.title: Sketch empathy map
tasks.description: Draw an empathy map for a target user using a paper template.

milestones.title: Human‑Centered Design Principles
milestones.outcome: Can identify core usability principles and evaluate simple interfaces.

tasks.title: Read Nielsen’s 10 heuristics
tasks.description: Read the Nielsen Norman Group summary of the 10 usability heuristics.

tasks.title: Analyze a website
tasks.description: Choose a popular website and note where each heuristic is met or violated.

tasks.title: Create site map on paper
tasks.description: Draft a site map for a small blog, organizing pages logically.

tasks.title: Reflect on findings
tasks.description: Write a short reflection on how the heuristics guided your site map decisions.

milestones.title: Intro to Visual Design
milestones.outcome: Can apply basic color, typography, and spacing rules in mockups.

tasks.title: Read MDN color basics
tasks.description: Study the MDN guide on color theory and contrast.

tasks.title: Watch typography tutorial
tasks.description: Watch a freeCodeCamp tutorial on web typography basics.

tasks.title: Create low‑fidelity wireframe
tasks.description: Use pen and grid paper to sketch a login screen layout.

tasks.title: Get feedback from a peer
tasks.description: Share the sketch with a friend and note one improvement suggestion.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop research, prototyping, and design critique abilities.

milestones.title: User Research Methods
milestones.outcome: Can plan and conduct a basic interview or survey with users.

tasks.title: Read interview guide
tasks.description: Read the UXPA article on conducting user interviews.

tasks.title: Draft interview script
tasks.description: Write a 5‑question script for a target user group.

tasks.title: Recruit 2 participants
tasks.description: Use social media to invite two volunteers for a short interview.

tasks.title: Conduct first interview
tasks.description: Run a 20‑minute interview and record key insights.

tasks.title: Summarize findings
tasks.description: Create a one‑page affinity diagram of the interview data.

milestones.title: Information Architecture & Flow
milestones.outcome: Can create user flows and sitemaps for moderate‑complex apps.

tasks.title: Read IA article on NNGroup
tasks.description: Study the NNGroup article about card sorting and IA.

tasks.title: Perform quick card sort
tasks.description: Use an online free card‑sorting tool with 5 friends to group app features.

tasks.title: Draw user flow diagram
tasks.description: Sketch a flow for a checkout process on paper.

tasks.title: Validate flow with a peer
tasks.description: Explain the flow to a peer and note any confusion points.

milestones.title: Prototyping in Figma
milestones.outcome: Can build interactive low‑fidelity prototypes and share them for feedback.

tasks.title: Create free Figma account
tasks.description: Sign up for a free Figma account and explore the interface.

tasks.title: Follow Figma basics tutorial
tasks.description: Complete the official Figma beginner tutorial on frames and components.

tasks.title: Build clickable prototype
tasks.description: Recreate the login screen wireframe as an interactive prototype.

tasks.title: Share prototype for critique
tasks.description: Send the prototype link to a design community and collect two comments.

tasks.title: Iterate based on feedback
tasks.description: Apply one suggested improvement and update the prototype.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio‑ready case studies demonstrating end‑to‑end UX process.

milestones.title: App Redesign Case Study
milestones.outcome: A documented redesign project that showcases research, IA, wireframes, and prototype.

tasks.title: Select an app to redesign
tasks.description: Choose a frequently used app that has usability issues.

tasks.title: Conduct 5‑minute heuristic review
tasks.description: Evaluate the current app using Nielsen’s heuristics and note pain points.

tasks.title: Run 3 user interviews
tasks.description: Interview three users about their experience with the app.

tasks.title: Create new IA and wireframes
tasks.description: Design a new site map and low‑fidelity wireframes in Figma.

tasks.title: Build interactive prototype
tasks.description: Turn the wireframes into a clickable prototype for key screens.

tasks.title: Write case study narrative
tasks.description: Draft a 800‑word case study describing problem, process, and outcome.

milestones.title: Usability Study Project
milestones.outcome: A documented usability test with findings and design recommendations.

tasks.title: Define test objectives
tasks.description: Write clear goals for what the usability test will evaluate.

tasks.title: Recruit 5 participants
tasks.description: Use a free participant‑recruiting sheet to enlist five testers.

tasks.title: Create test script
tasks.description: Write a step‑by‑step script for participants to follow.

tasks.title: Conduct remote test sessions
tasks.description: Run three 30‑minute remote sessions and record observations.

tasks.title: Analyze results and suggest fixes
tasks.description: Summarize issues and propose three design improvements.

tasks.title: Add study to portfolio
tasks.description: Create a portfolio page with screenshots, metrics, and recommendations.

milestones.title: Onboarding Flow Prototype
milestones.outcome: An interactive prototype that demonstrates a smooth first‑time user experience.

tasks.title: Map onboarding steps
tasks.description: Outline each step a new user should experience in a flow diagram.

tasks.title: Sketch low‑fidelity screens
tasks.description: Draw paper sketches for each onboarding screen.

tasks.title: Prototype in Figma
tasks.description: Create a high‑fidelity interactive prototype of the onboarding flow.

tasks.title: Run 3 quick usability tests
tasks.description: Ask three friends to complete the onboarding and note friction points.

tasks.title: Iterate and finalize prototype
tasks.description: Apply feedback and polish the prototype for portfolio display.

tasks.title: Document process in portfolio
tasks.description: Write a concise description of goals, methods, and outcomes for the case study.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance expertise, build professional presence, and prepare for job or freelance opportunities.

milestones.title: Design Critique & Feedback Loop
milestones.outcome: Can give and receive constructive design critiques confidently.

tasks.title: Read critique guidelines
tasks.description: Study the Design Critique article on the Interaction Design Foundation.

tasks.title: Join a design critique group
tasks.description: Participate in a free online design critique Slack channel for one session.

tasks.title: Present a portfolio piece
tasks.description: Share one case study and solicit structured feedback using the “I like, I wish, What if” format.

tasks.title: Write feedback summary
tasks.description: Summarize received comments and outline two action items.

tasks.title: Apply one improvement
tasks.description: Update the portfolio piece based on feedback and note the change.

milestones.title: Advanced Prototyping & Microinteractions
milestones.outcome: Can design and prototype subtle interactions that enhance usability.

tasks.title: Watch microinteraction tutorial
tasks.description: Watch the freeCodeCamp video on designing microinteractions in Figma.

tasks.title: Add animations to prototype
tasks.description: Implement hover and transition effects for a button in your existing prototype.

tasks.title: Test animation with users
tasks.description: Observe two users interacting with the animated prototype and note reactions.

tasks.title: Document interaction specs
tasks.description: Create a simple spec sheet describing triggers, durations, and easing.

tasks.title: Share animated prototype publicly
tasks.description: Publish the prototype link on a design community and gather comments.

milestones.title: Job & Freelance Readiness
milestones.outcome: Can market yourself, interview effectively, and secure UX work.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn profile
tasks.description: Add UX title, skills, and links to three portfolio case studies.

tasks.title: Create a one‑page resume
tasks.description: Use a free template to craft a concise UX‑focused resume.

tasks.title: Practice common interview questions
tasks.description: Answer five typical UX interview questions aloud and record yourself.

tasks.title: Research target companies
tasks.description: Identify three companies, note their design culture, and tailor your portfolio narrative.

tasks.title: Send outreach emails
tasks.description: Write and send personalized emails to hiring managers or potential clients.
